title: Static Routing Between Two Networks

errors.solution: Check syntax, reachable next-hop, and typos.

questions.question: What does ip route 192.168.2.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.0.2 mean?

questions.solution: Routing is bidirectional; return path required.

title: Default Route and Floating Static Route
objectives: Use default and floating static routes.
scenario: Configure static routes to reach remote networks not directly connected

errors.solution: Primary AD=1, floating AD must be higher, e.g., 200.

questions.question: When use default route?
questions.solution: On edge/stub networks with one exit path.

questions.question: Purpose of floating static route?
questions.solution: Backup redundancy; used only when primary fails.
